name: San Francisco Community Health Center / Trans:Thrive (formerly API Wellness)
description: Primary care, HIV testing and care, and trans-affirming drop-in services
fullDescription: San Francisco Community Health Center (formerly API Wellness) is a federally qualified health center offering primary care, HIV testing and care, behavioral health, and Trans:Thrive, a drop-in center for transgender and nonbinary people.
whatTheyOffer:
- Primary care at the Tenderloin clinic (730 Polk St, 4th Floor)
- Confidential HIV and hepatitis C testing, counseling, and treatment
- HIV+ care with case management and a drop-in center
- Trans:Thrive drop-in center (1460 Pine St, Mon-Fri 2-4:30 PM)
- Gender-affirming behavioral health, including couples counseling
- Accepts Medi-Cal and many PPO plans; sliding scale for uninsured patients
howToGetIt:
1. Call 415-292-3400 (Mon-Fri, 8:45 AM-4:45 PM) or request an appointment online
2. Same-day appointments may be available on a first-come, first-served basis
3. Walk-ins may be seen at the drop-in clinic or scheduled within 24 hours
4. Drop in to Trans:Thrive at 1460 Pine St weekday afternoons
address: 730 Polk St, 4th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94109
keywords: San Francisco Community Health Center, SFCHC, API Wellness, Trans:Thrive, TRANS:THRIVE, San Francisco, transgender, trans, HIV testing, hepatitis C testing, primary care, drop-in, trans-affirming healthcare, Tenderloin
